children: The December F&O series begins for the Nifty contracts on Wednesday, November 25, and history, as per evidence, has been more or less in favour of the bulls during the final F&O series of the year.

For the November series, the Nifty had surged 11.4%, marking its best move since April 2020 in a single series. The gains were led by the Nifty Bank, whose series-to-date gains of 15% were the highest since February 2021.
A major part of this upmove has been led by the consistent foreign inflows, which have crossed the ₹1.1 lakh crore mark for the month of November so far.
How Has The December Series Turned Out High?

The December series, historically, has shown no clear trend as most of the participants move away for their new year holidays, keeping volumes and participation low. The only anomaly has been December 2023, when the Nifty had surged over 8%. For the rest of the last four years, the index has largely consolidated in a narrow range.
However, history has largely been in favour of the bulls for the month of December, as the index has closed out the month with gains in 12 out of the last 18 years.
How Is FII Positioning Looking Like?

As a result of these foreign inflows, the net FII long positions at the start of the December series is now at 20.1%, which is the highest since July 2025. Net exposure for the start of the series is at 90,000 short contracts. Client long exposure at 70.2% from 81.4% in the previous month.
What Are The Key Triggers For the December Series?
Multiple triggers will need to be tracked even if the year is drawing to a close and new year festivities will begin.
Triggers will begin as early as next week with the November Auto sales figures on December 1, followed by the RBI Monetary Policy outcome on December 4.
The biggest global trigger for the month will be the outcome of the US Federal Reserve policy meeting, which will be disclosed on December 9.

In addition to that, monitoring the AI trade, developments around Nvidia, geopolitical developments, and whether the FII flows sustain in the Indian markets will also be watched closely by the market.

title: December F&O Setup: FII long exposure at start of series highest since 2025
